name: ModalPresence

props.name: _autoEnablePresence
props.description: Internal property for backwards compatibility. Specify whether the Modal should opt in to presence mode.

props.name: _presenceId
props.description: Internal property to predefine the presence context's id for exclusivity.

props.name: open
props.description: Specify whether the Modal is currently open

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon ModalPresence rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
